stage_1_smoke_test.description: Fast smoke verification for low vertex count and single hub routing.
Core residential topology testing 4-node rectilinear ring optimization.
Tests solver behavior at the 5-node / 100 m² single-hub capacity boundary.
Validates 2-hub contiguous graph partitioning and dual ring sequencing.
Stress-tests obstacle mesh routing, 8-room partitioning, and storage room handling.
